VIVA AT THE VINE
2268 W Broadway Vancouver

Condo – September 01
2 BR + Den + 2 BA  820 Ft2   $3600/Month

312-2268 W Broadway Vancouver BC V6K 0B1

Available September 01
Minimum 1 Year Term
Unfurnished
Pet Friendly
Secure Underground Parking
Storage locker in parking space

Professionally Managed by Hello Rent

Welcome to a wonderfully unique unit in the heart of Kitsilano, one of Vancouver’s most vibrant and sought-after neighbourhoods.

This charming 2 bedroom plus den, two bath unit is situated on the third floor, yet offers the feel and convenience of ground-level living.

Positioned above the building’s retail space, the residence opens directly onto a large landscaped courtyard, creating a peaceful and private setting tucked away from the activity of West Broadway.

Step outside onto your own private patio space, where you can enjoy your morning coffee, unwind at the end of the day, or simply enjoy the sanctuary of having a quiet outdoor retreat right outside your door.

The unit offers a comfortable and practical layout with two well-proportioned bedrooms and two full bathrooms, making it ideal for a couple, small family, professionals sharing, or anyone looking for the flexibility of an additional bedroom and workspace.

The additional den provides even more flexibility and can easily accommodate a home office, study area, or creative workspace.

There is a large flex room located just inside the entrance.
Much larger than a typical condo storage closet, this versatile space can be transformed into an oversized walk-in pantry, additional in-suite storage area, gear room, or organizational space, a particularly valuable feature for condo living.

Situated directly on West Broadway right above London Drugs, in the heart of Kitsilano, you are surrounded by an incredible selection of neighbourhood cafés, independent shops, bakeries, restaurants, grocery stores, fitness studios and everyday conveniences.

Kitsilano is renowned for its relaxed West Coast atmosphere, where established residential streets meet a lively collection of local businesses and some of Vancouver's favourite places to eat and gather.

For outdoor enthusiasts, the neighbourhood offers easy access to Kitsilano Beach, Jericho Beach, waterfront walking and cycling routes, neighbourhood parks and recreation facilities.

Whether your ideal weekend involves a morning run, cycling along the waterfront, relaxing at the beach or enjoying brunch on a patio, it is all within easy reach.

West Broadway is one of Vancouver's key east-west transportation corridors, providing convenient transit connections toward UBC as well as excellent access to Downtown Vancouver and other parts of the city.
